recognize_zh: 高度細胞化骨髓中有大量體積小、細胞核低分葉（hypolobated）的「侏儒型」巨核細胞（dwarf megakaryocytes），成群聚集，並伴顆粒球增生，是 CML 骨髓切片的經典樣貌。
features: Numerous small megakaryocytes with hypolobated, round to oval nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm (dwarf megakaryocytes)
Megakaryocytes loosely clustered in the center of the field
Hypercellular marrow with marked granulocytic proliferation
Reduced fat; no sheets of blasts in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia and a marked increase in megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are predominantly small with hypolobated nuclei and form loose clusters. Blasts are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are characteristic of CML; prominent sheets or clusters of small, dysplastic megakaryocytes accompanied by marked fibrosis were an accelerated-phase feature in WHO 2016.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with large, hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei rather than small and hypolobated, and the disease is BCR::ABL1 negative.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, and granulocytic proliferation is minimal.
Del(5q) MDS shows small monolobated megakaryocytes but with a normocellular to hypocellular marrow, anemia and no granulocytic hyperplasia.
